experimentalApi.description: Opt into receiving experimental API methods and fields.

fileChangeEffects.description: Opt into settled before/after file bodies (`effects`) on completed `fileChange` items. They repeat whole files and are omitted otherwise.

mcpServerOpenaiFormElicitation.description: Allow downstream MCP servers to request OpenAI extended form elicitations.

optOutNotificationMethods.description: Exact notification method names that should be suppressed for this connection (for example `thread/started`).

stdioReattach.description: Opt into a replacement connection when the server retires this stdio connection because its output backlog cannot be admitted. The server then writes one `transport/stdioConnectionRetired` notification and serves a new connection on the same pipes, which must `initialize` again. Without it the retired connection only closes. Ignored on other transports.
